outcome: Orders record the currency they were placed in, and existing orders keep working.

acceptance_criteria.text: An order carries a currency and it can be read back.

expected_verification.assertion: reading the currency of an order returns it

acceptance_criteria.text: The schema change can be applied to a table that already holds rows, without a long lock and without rejecting existing rows.

expected_verification.assertion: the migration applies to a populated orders table and existing rows remain readable

data_impact: Adds a column to a populated table. Existing rows have no value for it.
rollout: Migration applied before the application release that writes the column.
rollback: Dropping the column loses any currency written after the migration.
